page.layout: One column of names, with years printed in the left margin beside the lines; margin notes in the right margin (three notes).

main_text.l: 1323 Bruno Folkarding.Fugna Frif. contra Geldrum. Decretum Vpstallesb celebré.
1328 Ioannes Calmar.[?]rivilegium Vltraiect, in quatuor casib, Ecclesiast.

page.notes: The years 1322–1328 are printed in the left margin beside the names, so each is placed beside the line it aligns with. The first letter of the right-margin note on 1328 is set as a T-like form; it is read as P with [?]. The "Vpstallesb" in the first note is uncertain. The spelling of "Vltraiect" and "Ecclesiast" is as printed. Printed hyphen kept at "Horne-king".
